name: BSP_Startup_ResolveLanguage
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. thiscall, ECX is an out native string (008f8322 LEA ECX,[ESP+0xc]); returns this in EAX; RET 0. Seeds the string with 'english' (0041e870), builds <CSIDL_PERSONAL>\Battlestations-Pacific\options.txt via SHGetSpecialFolderPathA(5,fCreate=1) and the concat at 004261a0, and fopen(...,'rt'). On success the file is read into a memory backing and tokenised; a token matching 'Language' (00d15f1c, compare 00438e10) makes the next token the value (008f8070..008f808b). On fopen failure only, HKLM\SOFTWARE\Eidos\Battlestations Pacific value 'language' is read and, if REG_DWORD, mapped 0x407 german / 0x40a spanish / 0x40c french / 0x410 italian / default english (switch 008f7f9c). docs/WINMAIN_STARTUP.md

name: BSP_WinMain
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. stdcall(HINSTANCE, HINSTANCE, LPSTR, int) from the CRT at 00bfd0dd; both exits are XOR EAX,EAX / RET 10h, so the process exit code is always 0 and none of the four arguments is ever read (no frame access above the return address). Both COM-init failure branches still reach CoUninitialize. Then BSP_RandomThreads_Initialize, a one byte slot allocation gating BSP_RandomThreads_RegisterCurrent, and CreateMutexA(NULL, TRUE, 'MidwayThreadMutex'). A non-null handle with GetLastError()==ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS takes the already-running path: BSP_Startup_ResolveLanguage, a localized MessageBoxW (MB_ICONHAND) chosen by 00425850 comparisons, free of the language buffer, return 0 without closing the mutex or shutting the random subsystem down.
